I have an errand for you. My comrade Arseny worked at the factory as a tanker driver. His family left during the evacuation while he stayed behind to make some extra money, and perished here. He lived in a three-story dormitory near Polikhim, I don't remember the room. Anyway, he had a chain watch, a family heirloom. Bragged about it to everyone. Find that watch and bring it to me, I want to send it to his kid. I want the kid to have something to remember his old man by. The watch must be either in his room or in the tanker truck somewhere at the construction site. Arseny always kept the keys in his jacket. Anyway, do the job. The [[Machinery key]] is required to access the [[Bronze pocket watch on a chain|bronze pocket watch]]. So if you do not have one, head to room 205 located on the second floor of the three-story dorms building in the south.
  • File:Checking Map.png|Dorms location marked on map
    • To enter the room you'll need to jump on top of debris blocking the hallway and crouch to get inside the doorway of the room. The [[Machinery key]] can be found within the [[Jacket (Machinery key)|blue jackets]] beside the wardrobe.
  • File:DormRoom205Entrance.png|Room 205 File:Dorms.png|The jackets with the key
    • After obtaining the key, head north to the fuel tanker truck that is located at the construction site. The driver side door of the cabin can be unlocked with the [[Machinery key]].
  • File:Checking Map.png|Tanker truck location marked on map File:Machinery Key Door.png|The tanker truck
    • Inside, the [[Bronze pocket watch on a chain|Bronze pocket watch]] can be found laying on the floor in front of the seat. Be careful of the sniper Scav overlooking the truck from the roof of the nearby boiler building.
  • File:Machinery key inside.png|The pocket watch
    • After picking up the pocket watch, it will be placed in your quest items inventory. You must successfully extract with the pocket watch to hand it in. If you die before extraction, you will have to retrieve it again. Hand the pocket watch over to [[Prapor]] to complete the quest. {{Navbox quests}} [[Category:Quests]] [[cs:Kontrola]] [[de:Überprüfung]] [[fr:Vérification d'antécédents]] [[ru:Проверка на вшивость]]
